name: Arizona Woodworks
old_description: At Arizona Woodworks we employ the highest quality craftsman and the best materials to create the custom built cabinets, mantles, furniture, and commercial woodwork. A Prescott cabinet and woodworker for more than 30 years, we have the experience to design and build beautiful wood cabinetry and furniture   to fit any home or commercial application. …
about:
Arizona Woodworks operates from Prescott, Arizona, where it has been a cabinet and woodworking presence for over three decades. The company does not publicly disclose its exact founding year, ownership structure, or founders' names.

The shop produces custom built cabinets, mantles, heirloom furniture, commercial woodwork, and millwork. It emphasizes the use of skilled craftsmen and a range of wood species and finishes to meet both residential and commercial project requirements. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Customers include homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind furniture pieces and businesses needing commercial millwork. A 2019 testimonial from Rich and Pam Arnold notes the company delivered everything from garage shelving to artistic focal-point furniture, highlighting its ability to handle varied scales and design needs.

Arizona Woodworks states that its differentiation lies in employing the highest quality craftsmen and the best materials, a combination it says allows it to design and build wood cabinetry and furniture for any application.
